title: Plan December's content in one hour.

slides.label: Content planning
slides.title: Plan December's content in one hour.
slides.body: 5 steps. Comment MEDIA for the brand checklist.

slides.label: Step 1 · One goal
slides.title: Pick one thing December is for.
slides.body: Bookings, gift cards or getting found. One goal shapes every post.

slides.label: Step 2 · Three themes
slides.title: Choose three themes and stop.
slides.body: For example: the work, the team, and the question customers always ask.

slides.label: Step 3 · The calendar
slides.title: Put the posts on a calendar.
slides.body: Two or three a week is plenty. Mark the holidays and the days you're closed.

slides.label: Step 4 · One shoot
slides.title: Shoot it all in one session.
slides.body: Real photos and short clips of the work, captured in a single afternoon.

slides.label: Step 5 · Reuse
slides.title: Use each shot three ways.
slides.body: A carousel, a short video and a story, all from the same shoot.
slides.you: Fewer ideas, done well, look like a brand.

slides.label: Free checklist
slides.title: Planned it? Check it first.
slides.body: Comment MEDIA and we'll DM you the 10-point brand checklist we use before anything goes live.

caption:
Plan December's content in one hour. Comment MEDIA and we'll DM you the 10-point brand checklist we use before anything goes live.

1. Pick one goal for the month
2. Choose three themes and stop there
3. Put two or three posts a week on a calendar, around the days you're closed
4. Shoot real photos and short clips in one session
5. Use each shot three ways: a carousel, a short video, a story

An hour of planning now beats posting in a panic in the middle of December.

Save this and block the hour this week.
